title: REH Sample · Describe a classmate
objective: Use character adjectives and support them with an example.

blocks.title: Starting point
blocks.prompt: Write one adjective that describes a helpful classmate.

blocks.title: Character and evidence
blocks.body:
An adjective describes character.

Example: Maya is helpful because she explains difficult words to her classmates.
blocks.notes: Ask learners which part of the sentence provides evidence.

blocks.title: Choose the best adjective
blocks.prompt: Choose one answer for each question.

questions.prompt: Which adjective describes someone who shares willingly?

blocks.title: Recall without the example
blocks.prompt: From memory, write an adjective and a reason using because.

blocks.title: Write a short description
blocks.prompt: Write two sentences about a fictional classmate. Use a character adjective and one specific example.

questions.prompt: Which sentence supports the adjective with an example?
options: Sam is patient because he waits for others to finish.
